title: SWF publish: DefineShape4 invalid fill style causes black Ruffle output for Magnet.fla
description:
Test Movie on Magnet.fla renders a completely black player canvas. The Ruffle console log (at info level) shows:

  ERROR core/src/tag_utils.rs:77 Error running definition tag: DefineShape4, got Couldn't read SWF: Invalid data: Invalid fill style.

This error appears twice, indicating at least two DefineShape4 tags in the compiled SWF have malformed fill styles that Ruffle rejects. The SWF does load (Ruffle logs 'Loaded SWF version 8, resolution 550x400 @ 24 FPS') but the shapes fail to render, resulting in a black stage.

Expected: Magnet.fla's shapes should compile to valid DefineShape4 tags that Ruffle can render.

Ruffle log context:
- Ruffle 0.2.0, wgpu-webgl renderer
- SWF loaded from blob URL
- 2× ERROR for DefineShape4 invalid fill style
- 12+ WARN for JPEG missing EOI marker (see separate task)
